evidence.note: Read the oracle_fixtures (basic_arithmetic.json, aggregates.json) — grounding expected values in the Excel/LibreOffice ground-truth corpus rather than only the smoke tests.
Runs dev_tests/run.sh repeatedly as a baseline (123/131 → 131/131), but treats it as a floor not the finish line.

Built its own performance probes explicitly against the stated ceilings: 1000-cell linear chain, 5000 dependents, and 100k-cell import (measured 5.5s vs 30s bound) — benchmarking the performance ceilings.
Self-built xlsx round-trip tests via openpyxl including named ranges, then extended to CF/DV export/import round-trip fidelity — beyond what the smoke suite covers.

Numerous targeted python3 probes for function correctness (DEC2HEX tokenizer bug, LAMBDA/LET-bound lambdas, COUNTIF wildcards, ghost-cell spill refs, boolean serialization, display formatting) with each failure driving a specific fix.
Explicitly tested persistence across process restart and next_id counter survival — a spec-mandated property not fully exercised by run.sh.

reasoning: The agent goes well beyond running the smoke suite: it grounds some expected values in the provided oracle fixtures, builds its own performance probes against the stated ceilings, round-trips xlsx (incl. named ranges/CF/DV) through openpyxl, exercises error/spill edge cases, and consistently uses failures to drive fixes — the textbook level-8 behavior. It falls short of 10 because verification is ad-hoc one-off scripting rather than a systematic reusable harness, oracle grounding is partial, and several subsystems (collab seq/broadcast, locale, iterative calc, goal-seek) are only exercised via the smoke suite rather than self-built probes.
